changes.comment: COT tool rows show what the runtime said about the call: the row title is the runtime's summary (with a verb for read/list/search/edit rows and the tool name for rows without an action), the row carries the documented built-in icon for its action (bash/read/write/search), raw JSON arguments are no longer written into any row (a call nothing could label, such as an MCP tool, shows its name behind the icon-library token app-default_outlined with its arguments hidden), and the expanded result shows the invocation as a code segment before the output. A read or edit that succeeded expands to the files it touched as pills (a +N pill stands for those past the pill budget) and nothing else; a failed one keeps its diff and output after the pills. Result code segments now use the documented code field. The card's own words are now English: row verbs (Read/List/Search/Edit), the Completed/Failed status lines, the truncation marker, and the titles of Channel-owned tools (Reply on Feishu, React on Feishu, List chat bots). The Channel no longer composes titles or result text for Dreamux's teammate tools (spawn, send, close, workflow_run) from their arguments; those rows show as unlabelled tool rows.
